durability_semantics.effect_receipt_relationship: Cross-link resource and effect receipts by attempt id/digests, but neither substitutes for the other.
durability_semantics.external_attempt_window: Persist allocation/reservation and stable attempt id before provider attempt. On crash before receipt, mark indeterminate and conservatively charge/hold until resource-specific reconciliation; refund only on trusted contrary evidence.
durability_semantics.reservation_crash_window: Use expiring leases plus reconciliation; reclaim only after lease expiry and safe-use check.

feasibility_admission_relationship.non_effectful_work: May require resource allocation without effect admission.
feasibility_admission_relationship.operational_feasibility: Resource evidence may contribute only a blocking/narrowing condition and cannot make an otherwise infeasible effect feasible.
feasibility_admission_relationship.ordering: resource-class-specific early feasibility may narrow planning; effect grant/feasibility/admission remain independent; final resource check occurs after effect admission and immediately before effect attempt, with in-flight metering where needed

identity_lifecycle.child_creation: Issuer derives a child for a separately cancellable/observable semantic sub-action, binding parent current generation and a resource-specific delegation if entitlement is transferred.
identity_lifecycle.generation: Required to make renewal/revocation/currentness explicit; generation does not replenish allocations.
identity_lifecycle.revocation_expiry: Verifier rejects expired, revoked, superseded, broken-predecessor, or non-current issuer epochs. Cancellation normally cascades to descendants subject to safe resource cleanup.
identity_lifecycle.root_creation: Only a deterministic issuer may mint after validating explicit sponsor evidence (operator task, adopted maintenance configuration, or other future registered sponsor); bind work_item_id only as correlation.
identity_lifecycle.same_principal_rule: Propagate the same principal for ordinary service calls, implementation details, batching participation, and retries on behalf of the same activity.

first_consumers: proof budget attribution in observation-only mode
governed local-model invocation budget adapter after separate design/implementation approval

lineage_rules.child_budget: Child creation creates no entitlement. Delegation cannot exceed/resource-incompatibly transform the parent allocation.
lineage_rules.child_outlives_parent: No by default. Only a pre-expiry independent-sponsorship transition creates a new root; historical attribution cross-links the old child without inheriting entitlement.
lineage_rules.detached_work: Cannot remain an escaping child. It either remains cancellation/revocation-bound to its parent or completes an explicit independent-sponsorship transition before detach.
lineage_rules.independent_sponsorship: A fresh root issued from fresh verified sponsor evidence with its own lifecycle and allocator decisions; relabeling, detaching, queueing, or choosing a new ID is insufficient.
lineage_rules.parent_end: Cancel/revoke/expire child eligibility and resource-specific allocations unless an allocator recorded a valid narrower survival rule; effect cleanup remains separately authorized.
lineage_rules.shape: tree_for_sponsorship; shared work records a participant set/DAG reference outside parentage
lineage_rules.shared_work: Do not create multiple parents. Record participant causal references and let the resource subsystem allocate cost.
